description: Display live market prices from Finnhub (stocks, crypto, oil)
features: Single symbol quote — stocks, crypto, or commodities
Optional change line for 1h, 1d, or 1w, coloured by direction
Freeform symbol entry with aliases like BTC, ETH, oil, brent, wti, and gold
Configurable decimal precision and optional currency suffix
Press to refresh now; polls every 15 seconds otherwise
